name: payout calendar fills in with amounts
looks: A month grid of day cells builds on a solid colour field under a headline and a forecast total. Individual cells light up out of order with small payout chips (an icon and a signed amount) popping into place as the total above them ticks upward.
build: A DOM grid of day cells revealed with a short uneven stagger, like data-infographic's bar build generalised to a grid: each payout cell clips in with its chip (icon + amount) once its day lands, and the headline total rolls up on the same clock the cells use so they land together.
sound: A soft tick per cell that lights up, a slightly stronger chime on the cells carrying a payout chip, a rising tone under the total.
prompt: Build a month calendar grid of day cells on a solid colour field, under a headline and a running total that counts up. Let individual cells light up out of order, with a small chip (an icon and a signed amount) popping into the ones that matter, landing on the same beat as the total above.
